statement.zh: 将米拉多尔盆地简单定为「最早玛雅国家」或唯一首个国家，仍属排序性假说，不是本库定论。
statement.en: Ranking the Mirador Basin simply as the ‘first Maya state’ or unique primary state remains an ordering hypothesis, not library fact.
